# Create a Response object with the data 'Hello World!'
data = 'Hello World!'
response = Response(data)

# Set the 'content-length' header to the length of the data
response.headers['content-length'] = len(data)

# Set the status to '405 Not Found' and the status code to 401
response.status = '405 Not Found'
response.status_code = 401

# Get the value of the content_length property of the response
content_length = response.content_length
